blockers.detail: Owned council-beta routing queue is empty, while assist-bus telemetry reports four active council-beta helper slots. The assist-bus payload is larger than the connector response boundary and the active council-beta request records, including requestId and inputSignature, cannot be extracted without guessing. Acting without those exact fields would violate the workforce contract's root-owner/input-signature/dormancy controls.
blockers.lawfulNextEvidencePath: Read the exact active council-beta request records from a helper-scoped Assist Bus projection or another lossless bounded representation, then inspect each request packet/evidence and perform only the requested structural/risk support.

learning.strategy: Do not infer assist targets from ticker memory or truncated payloads; preserve exact request identity and root ownership before work.
learning.successSignal: Exact active council-beta assist request records become readable and bounded support can reduce root-owner uncertainty or blocker state.
